# 魏得恩 Wilbur Wei｜AI 資安演講、企業內訓與顧問

> 企業的資安幕僚，守住公司的營運與信任。魏得恩（Wilbur Wei，學術論文署名 Te-En Wei）是元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授，主持 MIRAGE Lab（代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室），也是 AI 資安講師與 AI 資安顧問，提供演講、企業內訓、顧問合作與 AI 賦能轉型服務。
> A cybersecurity advisor to the enterprise, safeguarding its operations and trust. Wilbur Wei (魏得恩), who publishes as Te-En Wei, is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Yuan Ze University and Director of MIRAGE Lab. He is an AI security speaker and consultant offering talks, corporate training, consulting and AI transformation services.

- 中文名：魏得恩；英文名：Wilbur Wei；學術署名：Te-En Wei
- 職稱：元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授；MIRAGE Lab（代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室）主持；AI 資安講師與顧問
- Title: Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Yuan Ze University; Director, MIRAGE Lab; AI security speaker and consultant
- 專長 / Expertise: AI Agent 資安、生成式 AI 資安、LLM 威脅建模、零信任架構、Active Directory 資安、AI 輔助資安防禦、資安治理與 ISO 27001、AI 賦能轉型、企業流程優化 / AI Agent Security, Generative AI Security, LLM Threat Modeling, Zero Trust Architecture, Active Directory Security, AI for Cybersecurity, Security Governance and ISO 27001, AI-enabled Business Transformation, Business Workflow Improvement
- 獎項 / Awards: 2022 R&D 100 Awards; CISC 2026 Best Paper Award (AHAF); CISC 2026 Honorable Mention (HMELF); CISC 2025 Honorable Mention (STIE-ZTA)
- 聯絡 / Contact: wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com（演講、內訓、顧問、AI 賦能轉型 / speaking, training, consulting, AI transformation）; wilbur.wei@saturn.yzu.edu.tw（學術與產學合作 / academic and research collaboration）

## 中文頁面

- [首頁](https://wilburwei.com/): 企業的資安幕僚，守住公司的營運與信任。魏得恩 Wilbur Wei，元智大學資工系助理教授、AI 資安講師與顧問。提供 AI Agent 安全、零信任與資安治理的演講、企業內訓及顧問合作，並延伸至 AI 賦能轉型與企業流程優化。
- [關於](https://wilburwei.com/about/): 企業的資安幕僚，守住公司的營運與信任。認識魏得恩 Wilbur Wei：元智大學資工系助理教授，學術署名 Te-En Wei。連結學術、政府稽核與企業實務，提供 AI 資安演講、內訓與顧問，並延伸至 AI 賦能轉型。
- [演講](https://wilburwei.com/speaking/): 為企業、產業公協會與教育機構安排 AI 資安演講，主題包含 AI 工具安全使用、AI Agent 攻防、零信任，並提供 AI 賦能轉型與流程優化方向。查看魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 的代表演講紀錄。
- [企業內訓](https://wilburwei.com/training/): 從 AI 安全使用、LLM 威脅建模與 SOC 實作，到企業 AI 工作流與流程改善。魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 依主管、一般同仁與技術團隊設計資安及 AI 應用內訓。
- [顧問](https://wilburwei.com/consulting/): 魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 提供 AI Agent 安全、零信任、AD 風險與資安治理顧問，並協助企業盤點 AI 導入與流程改善需求，討論評估範圍及可執行的優先順序。
- [資安幕僚](https://wilburwei.com/advisor/): 企業主資安幕僚站在老闆身邊，把資安風險翻成停工、罰則、商譽與客戶信任的語言，幫忙排優先順序。說明適合誰、做什麼、不做什麼。
- [指南](https://wilburwei.com/guides/): 給企業主的資安指南。用老闆聽得懂的方式，說明平常、出事與合規分別該找誰，並連到企業主資安幕僚說明與官方來源。
- [老闆不懂資安，該找誰？](https://wilburwei.com/guides/who-to-call/): 老闆不懂資安時該找誰：平常找能把風險講成生意的幕僚，出事向 TWCERT/CC 通報並向警政報案，合規對照金管會令、SEMI E187 與個資法。
- [資安顧問怎麼選？要看哪些條件？](https://wilburwei.com/guides/how-to-choose-advisor/): 選資安顧問時，先看他能不能把風險講成停工、罰則、商譽和客戶信任，以及建議是為了幫你決定，還是為了賣某一套產品。
- [企業主資安幕僚，和公司裡的資訊安全長、資安專責人員有什麼不同？](https://wilburwei.com/guides/advisor-vs-internal-roles/): 資訊安全長和資安專責人員是公司內部的正式職務；企業主資安幕僚站在老闆身邊幫忙看懂與排先後，不能代替法規要求公司自己設置的人。
- [公司中了勒索軟體，老闆前 24 小時要做哪些決定？](https://wilburwei.com/guides/ransomware-first-24-hours/): 中了勒索軟體，先隔離網路、不要關機、留下紀錄，並向 TWCERT/CC 通報；技術工作交給事件處理廠商。要不要付款，不要由老闆一個人在當下決定。
- [上市櫃公司的資安規定是什麼？我們公司適用哪一款？](https://wilburwei.com/guides/listed-company-cybersecurity-rules/): 上市櫃資安規定不是只有「要不要設資訊安全長」。人力配置看金管會令的分款條件；重大訊息與年報另有證交所、櫃買中心與金管會的規定。
- [SEMI E187 是什麼？供應鏈老闆要先懂的幾件事](https://wilburwei.com/guides/semi-e187/): SEMI E187 是晶圓廠設備的資安基準，不是政府法令。若客戶把它寫進訂單，老闆要先弄清自己的設備在不在適用範圍，以及要拿出哪些證據。
- [AI 賦能轉型](https://wilburwei.com/transformation/): 從流程盤點、AI 工具導入到試點與團隊培訓。魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 協助企業以 AI 優化文件、知識查詢與作業管理，結合資安設計及成效量測，並提供亞旭合作與相關演講經驗。
- [歷年紀錄](https://wilburwei.com/experience/): 魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 的 2024–2026 演講、授課與教材紀錄，包含 SEMICON Taiwan 2025、臺大電信所、國防大學、觀音與中壢產業園區、自強基金會，以及已排定的竣盟科技課程。
- [研究](https://wilburwei.com/research/): 魏得恩 Te-En Wei（Wilbur Wei）的研究計畫與成果：FY115 國科會 LLM 驅動紅隊代理平台計畫、七筆論文發表紀錄與三項論文獎，以及通訊與硬體資安的未來研究規劃。
- [MIRAGE Lab](https://wilburwei.com/lab/): 元智大學資工系 MIRAGE Lab 代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室，由魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 主持。既有研究涵蓋 AI Agent、紅隊攻防與零信任，規劃拓展至無人機、機器人通訊資安與 PUF 應用。
- [教學方法](https://wilburwei.com/teaching/): 魏得恩 Wilbur Wei 的教材設計方法：查核來源、從學員環境實跑、以情境練習連結概念與決策，並結合 AI 協作與人工定稿。

## English pages

- [Home](https://wilburwei.com/en/): A cybersecurity advisor to the enterprise, safeguarding its operations and trust. Wilbur Wei (Te-En Wei), Yuan Ze University: talks, training and consulting.
- [About](https://wilburwei.com/en/about/): A cybersecurity advisor to the enterprise, safeguarding its operations and trust. About Wilbur Wei (Te-En Wei): academia, government audit and industry.
- [Speaking](https://wilburwei.com/en/speaking/): AI security talks by Wilbur Wei on safe AI use, AI agent security, zero trust and AI transformation, with records from SEMICON Taiwan 2025 to industrial parks.
- [Training](https://wilburwei.com/en/training/): Corporate AI security training with Wilbur Wei: safe AI use, LLM threat modelling, SOC labs and AI workflows, tailored to managers, staff and technical teams.
- [Consulting](https://wilburwei.com/en/consulting/): Consulting with Wilbur Wei on AI agent security, zero trust, AD risk and governance, plus AI adoption and workflow assessment with practical priorities.
- [Advisor](https://wilburwei.com/en/advisor/): An advisor beside the owner translates security risk into downtime, penalties, reputation and customer trust, and helps set priorities.
- [Guides](https://wilburwei.com/en/guides/): Security guides for business owners, in plain language. See who to call day to day, during an incident and for compliance.
- [Who to call](https://wilburwei.com/en/guides/who-to-call/): Who to call if cybersecurity is unclear: an advisor day to day, TWCERT/CC and police in an incident, plus rules for listed firms, SEMI E187 and personal data.
- [AI Transformation](https://wilburwei.com/en/transformation/): AI transformation with Wilbur Wei: workflow assessment, AI adoption planning, pilot guidance and team training, with security design and evaluation built in.
- [Experience](https://wilburwei.com/en/experience/): Wilbur Wei’s 2024–2026 talks, teaching and courseware, including SEMICON Taiwan 2025, NTU, National Defense University, Zhongli Industrial Park and TCFST.
- [Research](https://wilburwei.com/en/research/): Research by Te-En Wei (Wilbur Wei): an FY115 NSTC LLM-driven red team agent project, seven publication records, three paper awards and planned research.
- [MIRAGE Lab](https://wilburwei.com/en/lab/): MIRAGE Lab at Yuan Ze University, directed by Wilbur Wei, studies AI agent security, red teaming and zero trust, with planned drone, robot and PUF research.
- [Teaching Approach](https://wilburwei.com/en/teaching/): How Wilbur Wei designs security courseware: source verification, learner-environment testing, scenario exercises, AI-assisted drafting and human review.
